name: Barley water (jau/talbina)
description: Strained barley infusion — a cooler in three traditions at once.

ayurveda.note: Yava is shita and mutrala — light and cooling, same logic as barley tea.

unani.note: Ma' al-sha'ir is a canonical Unani cooling prescription.

effects.note: Ayurveda names barley water mutrala — a diuretic — and folk use for urinary complaints echoes that across other traditions too. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
